pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: The Catalysis Flower is known for its lively and rapidly circulating spiritual energy. Alchemists associate it with the acceleration of spiritual transformations during refinement. It prefers windy hillsides and blooming fields where natural energy moves freely.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Meadows, windswept hills, windswept forests, and flower forests.
